rule: The block version, read as a signed 32-bit integer, is at least 4.
A block with a version above 4 has the rules of a version 4 block.
A full validator does not accept a block whose `nTime` is more than 2 h after the clock of the node.
An epoch starts at the `ACTIVATION_HEIGHT` of its upgrade and stops before the next one, so the block at `ACTIVATION_HEIGHT - 1` has the old rules.
`ActualTimespanDamped` truncates with `PoWDampingFactor` 4, and `ActualTimespanBounded` keeps it between 84 % and 132 % of `AveragingWindowTimespan`.
`median(S)` is the element of `sorted(S)` at the 1-based index ceiling((len + 1) / 2).
`MedianTime(h)` is the median of the `nTime` values of the 11 blocks before `h`, or of all of them when fewer exist.
`ToTarget(x)` is 0 when the sign bit is set, else the mantissa times 256^(exponent − 3).
column4: the core path; `expand_target` of hayai-wire, which the hash check uses, is not covered (hayai-gvf)

rule: `ToCompact(x)` gives the compact form of a target.
column4: the core path; `compact_from_target` of hayai-wire is not covered (hayai-gvf)

rule: `PostBlossomPoWTargetSpacing` is 75 s.
`PoWTargetSpacing(height)` is 150 s before Blossom and 75 s from Blossom.
`AveragingWindowTimespan`, `MinActualTimespan`, `MaxActualTimespan`, `ActualTimespanDamped`, `ActualTimespanBounded` and `Threshold` take the height as a parameter.
`PoWAveragingWindow` and `PoWMedianBlockSpan` do not change at Blossom.
`PostNU7PoWTargetSpacing` is 25 s.
`PoWTargetSpacing(height)` is 150 s, then 75 s from Blossom, then 25 s from NU7.
`PostNU7PoWAveragingWindow` is 102, and `PoWAveragingWindow(height)` is 17 before NU7 and 102 from NU7.
`PoWMedianBlockSpan` does not change at NU7.
`MeanTarget(h)` is the mean of `ToTarget(nBits)` of the `PoWAveragingWindow` blocks before `h`.
`nBits` equals `ThresholdBits(height)`.
The `nTime` of each block other than the genesis block is greater than the median-time-past.
`nTime` is at most the median-time-past plus 90 · 60 s, from height 2 on Mainnet and from height 653,606 on Testnet.
column4: the heights 2 and 653,606 are data of the network in hayai-consensus, not covered

rule: `Threshold(h)` is min(PoWLimit, floor(MeanTarget / AveragingWindowTimespan) · ActualTimespanBounded), `ThresholdBits` is its compact form, and `nBits` equals `ThresholdBits`.
`MeanTarget(h)` is PoWLimit when `h` is at most `PoWAveragingWindow`.
column4: hayai gives PoWLimit as the threshold there, as zcashd (open point hayai-8sc)

rule: On Testnet from height 299,188, a block more than 6 target spacings after its parent has the minimum difficulty (ZIP 205, ZIP 208), and Mainnet has no such rule.
column4: the start height is data of the network in hayai-consensus, not covered

rule: On Testnet from the height 299,188, a block more than 15 minutes after its parent has `nBits` = ToCompact(PoWLimit).
column4: the start height is data of the network in hayai-consensus, not covered

rule: On Testnet from the height 299,188, a block more than `6 · PoWTargetSpacing(height)` after its parent has `nBits` = ToCompact(PoWLimit).
column4: the start height is data of the network in hayai-consensus, not covered

rule: From NU7 on Testnet, the gap of the minimum-difficulty rule is 18 target spacings (ZIP 218).
Every use of `PoWAveragingWindow` in §7.7.3 (`MeanTarget`, `ActualTimespan`, the case `height <= W`) takes the window of the height.
On Testnet from NU7, a block more than 18 · 25 s = 450 s after its parent has `nBits` = ToCompact(PoWLimit); 451 s qualifies and 450 s does not.
From NU7 on Testnet, a block whose time is more than 18 target spacings (450 s) after its parent has `nBits` equal to ToCompact(PoWLimit).
